headline: OpenAI fires three safety researchers over information sharing
summary: OpenAI fired three safety researchers after an internal investigation found they mishandled sensitive company information by sharing it with an outside AI evaluation group.

claims.statement: OpenAI fired three safety researchers after an investigation found they mishandled sensitive company information by sharing it with an outside AI safety group.

sources.quote: OpenAI has parted ways with three safety researchers after an internal investigation found they mishandled sensitive company information, report says.
OpenAI fires three employees who allegedly shared info with an external AI safety group
The former employees were investigated for sharing data with an outside AI evaluation group.
